---
title: "clintonID"
format: html
---

```{r}
clinton <- read.csv("phoebechar/canoeing/clinton/data_repo_submission/full_clinton.csv")

clinton <- clinton |> mutate(id = if_else(is.na(personID), 0, 1))

clinton <- clinton |> group_by(year, bib) |> arrange(desc(personID)) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()

clinton <- clinton |> filter(time != 0)

ggplot(clinton, aes(x = id, y = time)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(group = id))
```
